title: Introduce self-described read/write protocol codecs and rendered profile-3

before.state: Origami used semantic-first T2 navigation and a separate exact/control plane, but ROSETTA did not yet formalize a paired read/write codec ABI and profile-3 existed only as a construction candidate.

after.state: Origami formalizes Protocol R0, semantic decoder/encoder registries, capability negotiation, Master Prompt R4 and a parallel rendered Fixed Carrier profile-3 that visibly declares S2/E2 semantic index procedures while preserving the 640x640 / 8192-byte envelope and profile-1/profile-2 compatibility.

corrected_interpretation: decoder use itself is not forbidden
a self-declared semantic decoder such as S2 is part of Origami
undeclared external decoder/file/binary dependency remains forbidden for Native semantic navigation
semantic questions must not escalate to exact codecs without need
encoder instructions are first-class so compatible models can construct new Origami messages
